description: Production weights inter-nucleon bonds by TYPE (d_for_ctype: pp 0, pn -h/2, nn -h), so the uniformity that BrunnianTripleExhaustion named as its free ingredient is already relaxed. It does not help: on the arithmetic-mean locus w_pp + w_nn = 2 w_pn, which production satisfies exactly, the triple/pair ratio is 2 identically and b3/b2 = -1 -- the same value the uniform chain gives, wrong sign, with h cancelling. Also relocates the exhaustion: it excludes the crossing-energy channel, which is none of the four evaluable channels in the seven-channel taxonomy.

mean_locus.vs_orderIndependent_iff: ChainBondOrderDependence requires L_pp = L_pn = L_nn, which production FAILS; the mean locus is strictly weaker and is what the isospin average actually needs

assertions.name: production's weights are NOT uniform -- mu is a WEIGHTED count
assertions.detail: d_for_ctype: sigma -> 0 (pp), averaged -> -h/2 (pn), sigma_inv -> -h (nn). So mu ∝ c does not describe production, and the exhaustion's free ingredient is already relaxed there -- one axis over

assertions.name: per-isotope mu IS arrangement-dependent
assertions.detail: 3H spans ['-1', '-3/2'], 3He spans ['-1', '-1/2'] -- which nucleon sits in the middle changes the bond multiset

assertions.name: but the ISOSPIN AVERAGE is arrangement-INDEPENDENT
assertions.detail: both extremes give mu_t = -1; the 3H and 3He arrangement shifts cancel against each other. I claimed mid-analysis that b3 was undefined without an ordering -- computing both showed otherwise, and this cancellation is why

assertions.name: the cancellation condition is the ARITHMETIC-MEAN locus, which production satisfies exactly
assertions.detail: w_pp + w_nn = -1 = 2 w_pn = -1. STRICTLY WEAKER than ChainBondOrderDependence.orderIndependent_iff's L_pp = L_pn = L_nn, which production FAILS (0, -1/2, -1 all differ) -- so Bbar(3) is well-defined though neither isotope's chain is

assertions.name: on that locus the triple/pair ratio is 2 IDENTICALLY
assertions.detail: mu_t = 2 w_pn and mu_p = w_pn, so the ratio is 2 with no dependence on the weights and none on h (Lean ratio_eq_two_of_mean)

assertions.name: hence b3/b2 = -1 -- wrong sign, and h cannot move it
assertions.detail: model -1 vs measured +0.6411239316, rel err -256.0%. h CANCELS in the ratio, so no q0 pin, convention or normalisation changes it

assertions.name: and it is the SAME -1 the uniform chain gives
assertions.detail: CarrierCrossingQuantisation's 'chain / coordination z = A-1' row is also -1. Weighting by type turns mu from a count into a weighted count and leaves the one number b3 can see exactly where it was -- so this is not an escape from the exhaustion, it is inside it

scope: (b) on type-weighted chain carriers, invariant named: on the arithmetic-mean locus the triple/pair ratio is 2, so b3/b2 = -1 for every such weighting. (a) elsewhere -- a weighting OFF that locus is not excluded here, but it buys an arrangement-dependent Bbar(3), which is a defect of its own since a nucleus has no middle.
caveats: RELOCATION, and it limits what the exhaustion binds: the excluded channel is the CROSSING-ENERGY one, which is not among the four evaluable channels of the seven-channel taxonomy. Production ships a trace-ratio channel that is neither extensive nor bond-additive. So neither the exhaustion nor this file binds the shipped channel.
The chain bond set is FORCED (StrandLayoutForcesChain), so this is not a choice of bond set. A different bond set is not available in this producer.
A=3 only. b4 and the A=4 carrier are untouched.

The weights are read from production's d_for_ctype in units of h. The colour-weighted 'averaged_weighted' ctype is NOT covered -- it carries a flavour split delta and may sit off the mean locus; that is the one type weighting this file does not exclude.
